title: Unstable work xDrip+ with G5 on Nexus 5.
body:
In the afternoon, when I use the phone, the transmitter works stably. At night or when I do not use the phone for more than 2-3 hours, the transmitter does not work stably(values from the transmitter come in 10 minutes, sometimes it happens as long).
 I make my phone in developer mode and enable that screen active while charging. In this mode. In this mode, with the charger connected, xDrip worked stably.

comments.body: Which android version is running on your Nexus 5 ?
Can you check that xDrip is set as not-optimized for battery optimization. Normally this is in Android Settings -> Apps -> Settings -> Battery Optimization

xDrip+ is set as not-optimized for battery optimization.
![img_20170615_145931](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5556887/27180582-cad9db68-51dc-11e7-8f33-a23afb3c635e.jpg)
@Lexsus my Nexus 5 didn't work well when WiFi was on. Also switch off WiFi and Bluetooth Scanning in Location preferences.

Anyone have problems with G5, please try the new `OB1 G5` collector. I have completely re-written the G5 support.

To do this, upgrade to the latest nightly version and in the `G5 Debug Settings` section, enable the `Try the new OB1 G5` collector. Please let me know what results you get. 

Make sure that when testing no other device is trying to connect to the G5, so switch off the official receiver, any other phones which might be accessing it and also any wear watch if you have ever used it as a collector.

I turned it on this morning and had good results. However, I had to turn it off because my watch was vibrating every 5 minutes, but no notification. Since I unchecked the try new OB1 G5 collector, my watch has stopped vibrating. I'm not using my watch as a collector and don't even have the xdrip app installed on it at this time. I'm using the Nsclient watchface.
I download latest xDrip +version, with OB1 G5 collector the Nexus began to work much better.

@Lexsus If you are not having problems with this any more, would you please close the issue?
Otherwise, would you please update as this is more than 3 years old?
